question: Among our top 10 paying customers, can you identify the largest change in payment amounts from one month to the immediately following month? Specifically, please determine for which customer and during which month this maximum month-over-month difference occurred, and provide the difference rounded to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH top10 AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM payment
  GROUP BY customer_id
  ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
monthly_payments AS (
  SELECT t.customer_id, 
         CAST(date_trunc('month', p.payment_date) AS VARCHAR) as payment_month,
         SUM(p.amount) as total_amount
  FROM payment p
  JOIN top10 t ON p.customer_id = t.customer_id
  GROUP BY t.customer_id, date_trunc('month', p.payment_date)
),
with_lag AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         payment_month,
         total_amount,
         LAG(total_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_amount,
         LAG(payment_month) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY payment_month) as prev_month
  FROM monthly_payments
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         payment_month,
         prev_month,
         total_amount,
         prev_amount,
         ROUND(total_amount - prev_amount, 2) as month_over_month_diff,
         ABS(total_amount - prev_amount) as abs_diff
  FROM with_lag
  WHERE prev_amount IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.customer_id,
       c.first_name,
       c.last_name,
       SUBSTR(d.payment_month, 1, 7) as payment_month,
       ROUND(d.month_over_month_diff, 2) as month_over_month_diff
FROM diffs d
JOIN customer c ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
ORDER BY d.abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 1
